author: DaFrozenBlaze
body: For the Gold and Emerald ranks which last for 3 months and 6 months respectively, they should add a timer on a profile to see how long til it ends. Or if not alert the player 1 week before or something. I just want to know when my rank ends because I don't know when I bought it. It would be useful.
